source.quote_free_summary: Recalls in multi-dance events use accumulated marks of all dances except in nine- and ten-dance events; the scrutineer computes multi-dance results under the Skating System and then adjusts for penalties; the Skating System is required at NDCA Sanctioned events.

requirement: NDCA Skating System scrutineering and multi-dance accumulated-mark recalls are NOT IMPLEMENTED for a future NDCA profile. The Studio callback engine tallies one dance per run and is not an NDCA recall method.
